title: CAREamics denoising pipeline parameters
description: Example Nextflow pipeline for training or applying CAREamics denoising models.

prediction_csv.description: CSV file with prediction samples. Must contain an image column and may contain a sample column.

pretrained_model.description: Path to a pretrained CAREamics checkpoint. If provided, training is skipped.

train_data.description: Directory containing training data. Required when pretrained_model is not provided.

target_data.description: Directory containing paired target data. Required for care and n2n training.

experiment_name.description: Name used by CAREamics for the training experiment.

data_type.description: Input data type passed to CAREamics.

axes.description: Axes for training data, for example SYX.

test_axis.description: Axes for prediction data, for example YX.

patch_size.description: Training patch size, passed as a space-separated list, for example '64 64'.

tile_size.description: Prediction tile size, passed as a space-separated list, for example '256 256'.

tile_overlap.description: Prediction tile overlap, passed as a space-separated list, for example '48 48'.

batch_size.description: Batch size used for training and prediction.

use_n2v2.description: Enable N2V2 when training an n2v model.
